class: Bitcoin full-node source trees already compared on this machine, plus Bitcoin Core as the secsov baseline and Knots because that checkout uses Core's src layout. GridPool is outside this class. The 2026-10-01 Commons Pool note is a reward-network request.

tree_methods.name: Implementation code
tree_methods.why: Size of the program the rules sit in. tokei code lines, one bucket per file.

tree_methods.name: Tooling
tree_methods.why: Files the role map marks as tooling. Spec lock lives here on commons.

tree_methods.name: Rules share
tree_methods.why: Share of implementation on the rules side of that tree's cut. The Core file cut, the crate-role cut, and the repository-role cut are separate instruments.

tree_methods.name: Left mixed
tree_methods.why: Share left in a crate or library the cut did not split.

tree_methods.name: Tests per implementation line
tree_methods.why: Test-bucket code lines divided by implementation code lines.

tree_methods.name: Lines in files of 1,000 or more
tree_methods.why: How much of the program sits in large files. Tooling is outside this share. Spec lock is tooling on commons.

tree_methods.name: Files holding half the program
tree_methods.why: Smallest set of program files whose code lines reach half the program code. Tooling is outside this count.

process_methods.name: Top-1 merge share
process_methods.why: Share of merged pull requests done by the single busiest merger. Cite the 2022+ window for the current bar.

process_methods.name: Top-3 merge share
process_methods.why: Share of merged pull requests done by the three busiest mergers. Same window as the top-1 figure.

process_methods.name: Maintainer self-merge rate
process_methods.why: Merged pull requests whose author and merged_by are the same person, among maintainer-authored merges. A missing merged_by is not a self-merge.

process_methods.name: Zero-review share of self-merges
process_methods.why: Self-merges with no GitHub review object in approved, changes requested, or commented. This is the roster artifact, not the partial-2026 rate.

process_methods.name: Authorship Gini
process_methods.why: Concentration of pull-request authorship. The period names are the temporal report's.

process_methods.name: Review Gini
process_methods.why: Concentration of review objects. Needs those objects. The period names are the temporal report's.

process_methods.name: Merger Gini (H4)
process_methods.why: Author-basis H4 is the indicator whose Spearman interval with log pull-request volume excludes zero (0.860, interval 0.588 to 0.970, n=17, 2026-10-11). Merger Gini from merged_by replaced that basis afterward. Neither number is copied into a cell.

process_methods.name: Bus factor (H5)
process_methods.why: Fewest people accounting for half of that year's merges. Computed from open and close timestamps, author, and merged state.

process_methods.name: Open stock (H2)
process_methods.why: Pull requests still open at year end, per pull request opened that year. The volume interval does not exclude zero.

process_methods.name: 24-month retention (H3)
process_methods.why: Share of an entry cohort with activity on or after the 24-month mark. The volume interval does not exclude zero.

process_methods.name: Median days to decision (H6)
process_methods.why: Median days from open to merge or close among decided pull requests. The volume interval is bound near zero and is not treated as excluding zero.

governance.status: Phase 1 is current. Enforcement is off and the keys are test keys. The signature counts are the written rule.
governance.quorum: When enforcement is on, two of three governance nodes in a written set must each conclude that an action conforms before that action stands. Anyone may run a node and publish a conclusion. Only the written set binds. Changing that set is a Tier 5 governance-rule change. The two written Tier 5 pairs both remain.

governance.layer_note: These bars are repository layers. Layers 1 and 2 share the constitutional name. Layer 1 is the specification and layer 2 is the proof crates, and both use 6 of 7 with a 180 day review and a 365 day consensus review. The 2 of 3 bar is the layer 5 maintainer signature on blvm-sdk. It is not the governance-node quorum. Action tiers are a second written table and are not drawn here. Tier 5 has two written pairs. Meta-governance is 5 of 7 plus 2 of 3 over 90 days, with a 30 day public comment. The tier 5 row is 5 of 5 over 180 days. Neither pair is chosen.

scan.rule_test: A statement that names a consequence is a rule, and a statement that names none is a norm. The rows below use that test on the files and the history this scan actually has. Judgment scores are not printed here, because they are not measurements.

items.name: commons
items.text: The design states a consequence. A non-conforming action is reversed when two of three governance nodes in a written set agree. Anyone may run a node and publish a conclusion. Only the written set binds. That consequence is Designed. It is not Running. Enforcement is off and the keys are test keys, so a commit stands when one author lands it.

items.name: commons
items.text: One author wrote 825 of 854 commits in blvm-node. The written rule names several signatures. The operating record and the written rule are different levels. That split is the peculiar form. It is not a guild. It is not a mixed constitution that is already operating. A mixed constitution in the institutional reading is a scored form with vetoes. commons on activation is a separate projection, and this page does not score that projection.

All-time, the top three hold 76.4% of merges, which is a different window. The small set that merges is the guild. The review norm did not disperse it.

Meta-governance is 5 of 7 plus 2 of 3 over 90 days, with a 30 day public comment. The tier 5 row is 5 of 5 over 180 days. This page does not choose between them.

items.text: Adding a maintainer is 5 of 7 where the roster lists 7 names. Removing one is 6 of 7 excluding the subject, on that same roster. Layers 3 and 4 list 5 names, and layer 5 lists 3. The names in the roster file are placeholders. Keyholder activation is 5 of 7 and is a different pool from maintainer signatures. The governance-node quorum is 2 of 3 in a written set. That quorum is not the layer 5 maintainer signature, which is also 2 of 3 and applies to blvm-sdk.

items.name: Bitcoin Core
items.text: First pull requests by non-maintainers have landed at 16.1% since 2022. Among closed outsider pull requests of 2,000 lines or more, 5.0% landed since 2022. Non-maintainers with five or more prior merges have landed at 68.6% in that window. On a merge outcome that includes self-merges, the maintainer odds ratio is 3.63 before prior merges are controlled and 1.36 after. The gate those findings support is at entry and on large new work. The comparison classes that newcomer pattern as ambient, including secp256k1, BDK, LND, and Eclair. Zero-review self-merges fell from 42.2% in 2017 to 4.0% in the 2026 partial year. Maintainer-authored pull requests that someone else merged with no review fell from 32.4% in 2017 to 8.8% in 2026. That fall is among work that reached review. It is not the filter before review. On the 2026-09-10 roster snapshot, 45.1% of maintainer self-merges have no review object, 1,129 of 2,501. That roster share is not the 2026 yearly rate.
